title: Private AI Platform: What It Is and How It Works
summary: A private AI platform allows organizations to host large language models locally to keep sensitive corporate data secure and meet strict privacy mandates.
body_markdown:
## Automating private AI workflows with Activepieces


Activepieces runs the automation engine within the same environment as the model weights, ensuring that sensitive API payloads never leave the corporate network. By executing workflows locally, organizations connect internal data to local models without exposing traffic to the public internet.


### Deploying automation within your own infrastructure


Every automation run executes on hardware the organization owns when Activepieces is deployed via Docker Compose or Kubernetes.


This deployment model keeps the execution logic and the data it processes behind the corporate firewall, so that a workflow querying a local SQL database never routes that information through an external cloud.


Every credential Activepieces touches (API keys, OAuth tokens, and connection secrets) can be routed to your own secret manager instead of a vendor database. By configuring a self-hosted instance against an external vault, you ensure that no vendor ever holds the credentials your business runs on.


The flow of data remains unidirectional and contained in this configuration. Following this setup, administrators can begin mapping specific access rights to the automated tasks.


### Securing AI agents with RBAC, SSO, and SCIM


Activepieces enforces Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Single Sign-On (SSO) to ensure AI agents operate under the same security constraints as human employees.


Integrating with internal identity providers via SCIM ensures that when an employee leaves the company, their access to AI workflows is revoked immediately across the entire stack.


Every interaction between an agent and a model like Mistral Large 4 is captured in immutable audit logs. These logs provide a forensic trail for compliance officers to verify that no unauthorized data exfiltration occurred.


### Air-gapped automations for regulated industries


Activepieces supports a fully air-gapped installation that functions without an outbound internet connection for highly sensitive environments.


This capability allows regulated firms to automate complex tasks, such as using Claude Sonnet 5.5 for document analysis, while the physical network cable remains disconnected from the outside world.


Unlimited self-hosted flows are allowed under the MIT-licensed core. Organizations can configure a self-hosted instance against an external secret manager to ensure credentials never leave their perimeter. Deploying the orchestration engine alongside local model providers eliminates third-party data residency risks.
